aboutLead: Emerge turns twenty five years of satellite fire detections into one fire calendar you can read for any place on Earth.
aboutWhatBody: Two families of satellite instruments have watched for fires since November 2000. They see the ground differently, so their counts cannot be compared directly. Emerge puts both on one scale, month by month, and shows the result as a calendar with the years down the side and the months across the top. Pick a point, type a latitude and longitude, draw an area or choose a country, and the record for that place is what you read.
aboutHonestBody: It is not a warning service and it does not predict fires. Values before 2012 are estimated from the older instruments and are marked as estimated wherever they are shown. Months with no measurement are shown differently from months where the satellites looked and saw nothing.
aboutOfficialBody: For current fire danger and official warnings, use the services below.
aboutCreditsBody: Every outside dataset, service and library we build on, with its licence.
proofTitle: How we know it is right
proofBody: This page will show the checks behind the numbers: how the conversion scored on years it never saw, how the two satellite families agree with each other, how wide the error ranges are, and where the method is weak. The numbers come from a file the pipeline writes, never from text typed by hand.
